offering_description.value: Operates a portfolio of online dating and social discovery apps and websites for consumers seeking romantic and social connections. Revenue comes mainly from user subscriptions and in-app purchases delivered through mobile app stores and websites.

primary_products.value: dating apps; premium subscriptions; in-app purchases

primary_services.value: online dating and matchmaking platforms; social discovery services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual singles using dating apps worldwide

end_markets.value: online dating; social discovery; consumer internet

revenue_model.value: subscription: paid monthly or multi-month premium subscriptions to dating apps; transaction or usage fees: a la carte in-app purchases such as boosts and super likes; advertising: some advertising revenue on certain apps
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and runs dating app platforms used by consumers, sold via app stores; brand owner: owns portfolio of dating brands marketed to singles

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America, in many languages

specialization.value: niche specialist: online dating across multiple brands for different demographics and regions

distribution_channels.value: online: apps downloaded via Apple App Store and Google Play, plus company websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy, consumer protection, subscription billing and online safety rules (FTC, GDPR, app store policies)
